lessons.title: The solar constant
lessons.goal: Understand how much sunlight reaches a directly facing surface outside the atmosphere.

lessons.title: Radiation across a planet
lessons.goal: Understand why the sunlight averaged over a whole spherical planet is S/4.

lessons.title: Albedo
lessons.goal: Understand the fraction of sunlight reflected and how much is left to be absorbed.

lessons.title: Changing albedo
lessons.goal: Understand why reflection changes and how this can affect warming.

lessons.title: Emissivity
lessons.goal: Understand why surfaces at the same temperature can emit different amounts of radiation.

lessons.title: Greenhouse gases
lessons.goal: Understand what makes a gas a greenhouse gas and where these gases come from.

lessons.title: Absorption and emission
lessons.goal: Understand how molecules absorb infrared energy and how the atmosphere emits it.

lessons.title: Enhanced greenhouse effect
lessons.goal: Understand how more greenhouse gas can lead to warming while energy is still conserved.

lessons.title: Equilibrium temperature
lessons.goal: Bring sunlight, reflection and thermal emission together to estimate a planet’s steady temperature.

lessons.title: Surface–atmosphere balance
lessons.goal: Understand the energy exchanges of the surface, the atmosphere and the two together.
